checks.name: assignment_attempts_score_state_check
checks.expression:
score is null or coalesce(
      submitted_at is not null
      and result->>'gradingVersion' in ('truth_table_v1', 'mixed_v1')
      and jsonb_typeof(score) = 'object'
      and score->>'scoringVersion' = 'points_v1',
      false
    )
checks.definition:
check (
    score is null or coalesce(
      submitted_at is not null
      and result->>'gradingVersion' in ('truth_table_v1', 'mixed_v1')
      and jsonb_typeof(score) = 'object'
      and score->>'scoringVersion' = 'points_v1',
      false
    )
  )

triggers.name: assignment_attempts_submitted_immutable

checks.name: assignment_items_max_points_check
checks.expression: max_points is null or max_points between 1 and 1000
checks.definition: check (max_points is null or max_points between 1 and 1000)

checks.name: assignments_answer_reveal_state_check
checks.expression:
(answers_revealed_at is null and answers_revealed_by_id is null)
    or (answers_revealed_at is not null and answers_revealed_by_id is not null
      and assessment_mode in ('graded', 'completion_only') and solution_access = 'instructor_release'
      and published_at is not null and answers_revealed_at >= published_at)
checks.definition:
check (
    (answers_revealed_at is null and answers_revealed_by_id is null)
    or (answers_revealed_at is not null and answers_revealed_by_id is not null
      and assessment_mode in ('graded', 'completion_only') and solution_access = 'instructor_release'
      and published_at is not null and answers_revealed_at >= published_at)
  )

checks.name: assignments_grade_release_state_check
checks.expression:
(grades_released_at is null and grades_released_by_id is null)
    or (grades_released_at is not null and grades_released_by_id is not null
      and assessment_mode = 'graded' and grade_release_timing = 'instructor_release'
      and published_at is not null and grades_released_at >= published_at)
checks.definition:
check (
    (grades_released_at is null and grades_released_by_id is null)
    or (grades_released_at is not null and grades_released_by_id is not null
      and assessment_mode = 'graded' and grade_release_timing = 'instructor_release'
      and published_at is not null and grades_released_at >= published_at)
  )

checks.name: assignments_learning_policy_check
checks.expression:
(assessment_mode = 'graded' and feedback_timing = 'on_submission')
    or (assessment_mode = 'completion_only' and feedback_timing in ('on_submission', 'on_check', 'immediate'))
    or (assessment_mode = 'ungraded_practice' and feedback_timing in ('on_check', 'immediate'))
checks.definition:
check (
    (assessment_mode = 'graded' and feedback_timing = 'on_submission')
    or (assessment_mode = 'completion_only' and feedback_timing in ('on_submission', 'on_check', 'immediate'))
    or (assessment_mode = 'ungraded_practice' and feedback_timing in ('on_check', 'immediate'))
  )

checks.name: assignments_scoring_version_check
checks.expression: scoring_version is null or (scoring_version = 'points_v1' and assessment_mode = 'graded')
checks.definition: check (scoring_version is null or (scoring_version = 'points_v1' and assessment_mode = 'graded'))

checks.name: billing_plans_terms_check
checks.expression: (billing_model = 'one_time' and coverage_days is not null and coverage_days > 0 and billing_interval is null) or (billing_model = 'recurring' and coverage_days is null and billing_interval is not null and billing_interval in ('month', 'year'))
checks.definition: check ((billing_model = 'one_time' and coverage_days is not null and coverage_days > 0 and billing_interval is null) or (billing_model = 'recurring' and coverage_days is null and billing_interval is not null and billing_interval in ('month', 'year')))

checks.name: demo_workspaces_lifetime_check
checks.expression: created_at <= last_activity_at and last_activity_at < idle_expires_at and idle_expires_at <= expires_at
checks.definition: check (created_at <= last_activity_at and last_activity_at < idle_expires_at and idle_expires_at <= expires_at)

checks.name: durable_jobs_attempts_check
checks.expression: max_attempts between 1 and 10 and attempts between 0 and max_attempts
checks.definition: check (max_attempts between 1 and 10 and attempts between 0 and max_attempts)

checks.name: durable_jobs_state_check
checks.expression: (status = 'queued' and attempts < max_attempts and lease_token is null and lease_expires_at is null and completed_at is null) or (status = 'running' and attempts > 0 and lease_token is not null and lease_expires_at is not null and completed_at is null) or (status in ('succeeded', 'failed') and attempts > 0 and lease_token is null and lease_expires_at is null and completed_at is not null)
checks.definition: check ((status = 'queued' and attempts < max_attempts and lease_token is null and lease_expires_at is null and completed_at is null) or (status = 'running' and attempts > 0 and lease_token is not null and lease_expires_at is not null and completed_at is null) or (status in ('succeeded', 'failed') and attempts > 0 and lease_token is null and lease_expires_at is null and completed_at is not null))

checks.name: job_runs_finished_check
checks.expression: finished_at is null or finished_at >= started_at
checks.definition: check (finished_at is null or finished_at >= started_at)

checks.name: job_runs_state_check
checks.expression: (status = 'running' and finished_at is null and error_code is null) or (status = 'succeeded' and finished_at is not null and error_code is null) or (status in ('failed', 'lease_expired') and finished_at is not null and error_code is not null)
checks.definition: check ((status = 'running' and finished_at is null and error_code is null) or (status = 'succeeded' and finished_at is not null and error_code is null) or (status in ('failed', 'lease_expired') and finished_at is not null and error_code is not null))

triggers.name: problem_versions_immutable

checks.name: users_identity_check
checks.expression: (identity_provider = 'cognito' and cognito_user_pool_id is not null and cognito_subject is not null and demo_workspace_id is null) or (identity_provider = 'demo' and cognito_user_pool_id is null and cognito_subject is null and email is null and demo_workspace_id is not null)
checks.definition: check ((identity_provider = 'cognito' and cognito_user_pool_id is not null and cognito_subject is not null and demo_workspace_id is null) or (identity_provider = 'demo' and cognito_user_pool_id is null and cognito_subject is null and email is null and demo_workspace_id is not null))
